maintenance_led.reason: Sells new single-use surgical implants, regenerative products and instruments (DuraGen, Integra Dermal Regeneration Template), not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Medical devices sold to hospitals and surgeons, paid mainly by commercial insurers, patients and hospitals; government share is not the majority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own neurosurgery and tissue technology product sales and launches, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: FDA-regulated implants like DuraGen and hydrocephalus valves; surgeons trained on them, so switching needs retraining and clinical requalification.
